title: the Meridian retention claim
card: Meridian, consolidated. Three subscription plans became two on a price-change date, and the retention deck on your desk claims monthly churn improved 2.1 points after the change. It wants that number in the board pack.
Fifteen auditors will take the analysis apart — the grain, the definitions, the counter-story. Engines compute every figure twice. You are the VP: nothing becomes true until you sign it.
